mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 59 degrees out by the Military Ridge State Trail, under a waning crescent moon.

In city news, a 34-year-old Madison resident, Halla Nelson, was arrested on Friday, September 4, for sexual assault of a child by a school staff member regarding an incident from 2019. Additionally, residents should prepare for phase two of the Aldi development and road construction on Highway M, which begins the week of September 7 and will cause traffic shifts.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy Hop Haus trivia or the quizmasters trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Wednesday features music and trivia at several local spots.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Friday, September 4, they booked a school staff member into the Dane County Jail following an investigation into an inappropriate relationship with a student from 2019.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:00 PM.
